# espalier_system (Data Source)

The container runtime on this host: whether it runs, its versions, the default kernel and the defaults from its `config.toml` (`container system property list`). A stopped runtime is reported, not an error, so configurations can check it as a precondition (espalier never starts the runtime: run `container system start`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Fail early, with a useful message, when the runtime is not started.
data "espalier_system" "this" {
  lifecycle {
    postcondition {
      condition     = self.running
      error_message = "The container runtime is ${self.status}: run `container system start`."
    }
  }
}

output "runtime" {
  value = "container ${data.espalier_system.this.client_version}, kernel ${data.espalier_system.this.kernel_binary_path}"
}

# Short image names resolve against this registry.
output "registry" {
  value = data.espalier_system.this.registry_domain
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `builder_defaults` (Attributes) The builder container's settings, unless the provider's `builder` overrides them. Null while the runtime is stopped. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--builder_defaults))
- `client_version` (String) Version of the `container` command line tool.
- `container_defaults` (Attributes) Defaults for containers that do not set them. Null while the runtime is stopped. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--container_defaults))
- `dns_domain` (String) Local DNS domain appended to container names; null if unset. Null while the runtime is stopped.
- `kernel_binary_path` (String) Path of the default kernel inside its archive. Null while the runtime is stopped.
- `kernel_digest` (String) Digest of the default kernel archive. Null while the runtime is stopped.
- `kernel_url` (String) Where the default kernel archive comes from. Null while the runtime is stopped.
- `machine_defaults` (Attributes) Defaults for machines that do not set them. Null while the runtime is stopped. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--machine_defaults))
- `network_subnet` (String) Default IPv4 subnet for new networks; null if unset. Null while the runtime is stopped.
- `network_subnet_v6` (String) Default IPv6 prefix for new networks; null if unset. Null while the runtime is stopped.
- `registry_domain` (String) Registry that short image references resolve to, e.g. `docker.io`. Null while the runtime is stopped.
- `running` (Boolean) Whether the runtime's services are running.
- `server_version` (String) Version of the runtime's API server. Null while the runtime is stopped.
- `status` (String) Status as reported by `container system status`, e.g. `running`, or `unregistered` after `container system stop`.
- `vminit_image` (String) Default init image of container VMs. Null while the runtime is stopped.

<a id="nestedatt--builder_defaults"></a>
### Nested Schema for `builder_defaults`

Read-Only:

- `cpus` (Number) CPUs.
- `image` (String) Builder image.
- `memory` (String) Memory, e.g. `2G`.
- `rosetta` (Boolean) Whether builds can use Rosetta for x86-64.


<a id="nestedatt--container_defaults"></a>
### Nested Schema for `container_defaults`

Read-Only:

- `cpus` (Number) CPUs.
- `dns` (Attributes) Resolver configuration. The runtime's defaults apply to whatever is not set. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--container_defaults--dns))
- `memory` (String) Memory, in the largest whole unit, e.g. `1G`.

<a id="nestedatt--container_defaults--dns"></a>
### Nested Schema for `container_defaults.dns`

Read-Only:

- `domain` (String) Default domain.
- `nameservers` (List of String) Nameserver IP addresses.
- `options` (List of String) Resolver options, e.g. `ndots:2`.
- `search_domains` (List of String) Search domains.



<a id="nestedatt--machine_defaults"></a>
### Nested Schema for `machine_defaults`

Read-Only:

- `cpus` (Number) CPUs.
- `home_mount` (String) How the home directory is mounted.
- `memory` (String) Memory, e.g. `12G`.
- `virtualization` (Boolean) Nested virtualization.
